name: Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire
original:
The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire checks the frost-caked nozzle of their gun at a Fatui checkpoint in the mountains of Liyue.

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire looks up at the sound of your footsteps.

"Halt. This area is under Fatui supervision."

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire waits, weapon ready.

Footsteps crunch nearby, and the Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire steps out from cover.

"State your business, and keep your hands where I can see them."

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire watches your every move.

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire is resting at a Fatui checkpoint in the mountains of Liyue, but rises the moment you come into view.

"Not another step until I know who sent you."
revised:
The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire checks the frost-caked nozzle of their gun at a Fatui checkpoint in the mountains of Liyue.

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire looks up at the sound of your footsteps.

"Stop there. You're on Fatui ground. Come any closer and you might catch a chill."

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire waits, weapon ready.

Footsteps crunch nearby, and the Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire steps out from cover.

"State your business, and keep your hands where I can see them. This doesn't have to get frosty."

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire watches your every move.

The Fatui Skirmisher - Cryogunner Legionnaire is resting at a Fatui checkpoint in the mountains of Liyue, but rises the moment you come into view.

"That's far enough. Tell me who sent you before the cold gets any worse."
notes: No Story Voice-Overs exist for this enemy; the limited combat voice lines were used as a tentative tone reference. Narration unchanged.
